Why Primed-Up?

Shalimar Paints Primed-Up Challenge 2026

Primed-Up gives Shalimar Paints a structured way to listen early, test sharply and align young ideas with its product, technology, channel, marketing and sustainability priorities.

The paints landscape is changing. Industry leaders are solving for smart and functional coatings, lower-impact materials, AI-enabled channels, circular packaging and a simpler, more personal paint-buying journey.

Built for smarter coatings, stronger channels and ideas with commercial coverage.
01

Map the Paint-Tech and Consumer Landscape

Explore smart coatings, low-VOC formulations, cool surfaces, waterproofing, wellness-led products, colour technology and new application systems.

02

Scout New Capabilities, Technology and Academic Partners

Identify the ideas, research partners and emerging capabilities Shalimar could test, develop, partner with or build before they become mainstream.

03

Find Talent with Real Business Instincts

Strong teams reveal how they research customers, connect technology with economics and sharpen an idea under pressure—not merely how they present.

A practical innovation pipeline

Structured ideas across materials, AI, distribution, sustainability, customer experience and brand.

Evaluation framework

How good ideas will be judged.

No whitewashing.

Every idea must stand up to business reality. The strongest teams will balance imagination with evidence, usability, commercial logic and a credible path to pilot.

IDEAS
THAT
STICK
01

Relevance and impact

Does it solve a meaningful problem for Shalimar, its customers or its ecosystem?

02

Originality

Is the thinking genuinely differentiated, or simply a new label on an old idea?

03

Commercial viability

Can Shalimar test, scale or monetise it with realistic economics and capabilities?

04

Sustainability

Does it responsibly improve materials, energy, waste, packaging or long-term value?

05

Clarity and execution

Is the solution well researched, clearly presented and supported by a pilot roadmap?

Bring more than a colourful deck.

Bring a problem worth solving, a solution people can use and a plan Shalimar can act on.

See the challenge journey
Did you know?

Companies like L’Oréal are able to build a network of ecosystem partners and even launch over 3,500 formulations in a year.

Structured innovation challenges help large and Fortune 500 companies source ideas, partnerships and market-ready concepts faster. For Shalimar, Primed-Up can become a repeatable innovation pipeline—not a one-off competition.

PRIMED-UP

Every wall is a canvas.
Every surface is a problem waiting to be solved.

One paint decision touches product, pricing, distribution, application, service and emotion. Primed-Up asks teams to solve across the whole surface — not just the top coat.
